assertions.assertion: Response explains the cookie extends because IdentityServer re-issues it via SignInAsync when the session's client list changes
assertions.rationale: It attributes the extension to sliding expiration renewing the cookie per request, not to IdentityServer re-issuing the cookie via SignInAsync when the session's client list changes.

assertions.assertion: The web.app client sets UserSsoLifetime to an 8-hour value (28800 seconds) to force interactive re-authentication
assertions.rationale: The response never sets UserSsoLifetime; it relies on CookieLifetime plus disabling sliding expiration, which does not force interactive re-auth against the SignInAsync re-issue behavior.

assertions.assertion: The client sets RefreshTokenExpiration = TokenExpiration.Absolute together with AbsoluteRefreshTokenLifetime to cap refresh-driven session extension
assertions.rationale: web.app sets AbsoluteRefreshTokenLifetime = 8 * 3600 and RefreshTokenExpiration = TokenExpiration.Absolute to cap refresh-token-driven extension.
